_comment: Dependencies the production Odysseus venv needs for the Projects (official Hermes Webapp) backend. Installed offline from the staged, hash-checked wheel; nothing is fetched at install time.

websockets.why: uvicorn ws=auto finds no WebSocket library without it, so the Hermes proxy would answer every WebSocket upgrade with an error
websockets.tested_with: websockets 17.4, uvicorn 0.54.0, Python 3.12.10 (lab venv identical to production); proxy tests pass under websockets and websockets-sansio
